references.text: Jesus' answer to Philip that asking the Father in His name is the same as asking the Father directly confirms Mary's belief that God gives everything He is asked for.
The promise that all things asked will be given if one remains in Jesus and His words reflects Mary's conviction of God's unconditional response to prayer.
Jesus' statement that the Father will give all things asked in His name is a direct theological parallel to Mary's expression that God gives everything He is asked for.
The Father Himself loves the disciples and answers their prayers, which supports Mary's belief that God personally gives what He is asked for.
Jesus' own prayer before raising Lazarus confirms Mary's faith: He knows that the Father always hears and gives what He is asked for.
